audit.method: Read from the full term sheet by one AI reviewer, then checked against it twice by independent AI reviewers: first every line of the record against the document, then the document section by section against the record. Not signed off by a person. Every quote is looked up in the PDF text each time the tool runs.
audit.open_points:
Final record written to C:\Users\AFarid\Documents\Hackathon\key_credit_terms\data\audited\fluence_2026.json. Checker: structure OK, 45 quotes exact, none loose, missing or on another page. Every row of both slides maps to a template row or to doc.notes (pricing, SOFR floor, consent fee have no template row). Every figure, date and section number was confirmed against the dump and the page images, including existing versus proposed column; no wrong figure, party or column was found. Searches of the dump for transfer, default, prepayment, change of control, reporting, governing law, purpose, extension and cure wording found nothing, so the 15 not_stated rows stand.

What the document cannot resolve:
1. 'Trigger Date' is not defined, and the term sheet does not say what applies from that date. The existing column also describes the Section 6.05(a)(ix)(A) and 6.05(b)(iv) baskets as available only 'prior to the Trigger Date'; recorded as printed.
2. fc_interest_cover 'none' (stated) reads the Financial Covenant row as the complete covenant package. The row has no closing words, and the slides are an amendment summary, so an unamended interest cover test in the existing Credit Agreement cannot be excluded from this document alone.
3. conditions_subsequent stays by_reference on one 'Additional Amendments' bullet about bank account security acknowledgments ('TBD'). The term sheet does not call it a condition subsequent or give a deadline; the printed line says so. A stricter reader would mark it not_stated.
4. The Parent is not named and no jurisdiction or governing law is given. 'Fluence Energy, Inc.' appears only in the footer copyright on the page images (garbled in the dump, so it cannot be quoted) and was not used as the Parent's name.
5. The term sheet does not say what the $50m cash collateral secures, or what its release conditions are ('to be mutually agreed').
6. The proposed designated non-cash consideration basket is 'greater of $25 million and the corresponding percentage of Total Assets'; the percentage is not given and was not calculated.
7. purpose stays not_stated. The LC Sublimit row says how the facility may be used (LCs up to the full amount, cash draws up to $150m), not what utilisations are for; a looser reader could treat letters of credit as a stated purpose.
8. doc.kind is left as lender_presentation (two numbered slides with existing/proposed columns), which is also how kct/rules classes side-by-side pages. The first auditor reports that a benchmark record says 'summary'; I did not open it.
9. The accordion quote reads 'incremental' where the dump has 'increm ental' (a split word in the PDF text); the checker ignores whitespace and grades it exact.

doc.title: Proposed Terms for Secured Revolving Credit Facility
doc.notes: Two slides (numbered 7 and 8) from a Fluence presentation setting out a proposed amendment to the existing $500m senior secured revolving credit facility, as a table with 'Existing Terms' and 'Proposed Terms' columns; both pages hold terms. It covers only the points being amended or confirmed 'Same as existing' and cites sections of the existing Credit Agreement without reproducing them, so most covenant, default, transfer and reporting terms are not in it. Many proposed changes apply 'prior to the Trigger Date', which is not defined. Pricing is shown as 'Same as existing' (drawn S + 300 bps, undrawn 50 bps, LC 3.00%, SOFR floor 0.00%) and a 10 bps consent fee is shown; neither has a row in the template. The slide titles and footers are garbled in the extracted text and were read from the page images.
